title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For Itchy Skin
intro: Herbal creams for itchy skin are topical preparations made from plant extracts, used to soothe and calm irritated skin, providing relief from itchiness and discomfort. The benefits of using herbal creams to treat itchy skin include their natural, non-irritating, and often fragrance-free properties, making them a popular choice for those with sensitive skin. Examples of herbal creams for itchy skin include Aloe vera gel, which cools and moisturizes the skin, Chamomile cream, which has anti-inflammatory and soothing properties, Calendula cream, which promotes wound healing and reduces redness, and Tea tree oil cream, which has antifungal and antibacterial properties to combat skin infections. Additionally, other herbal creams such as Echinacea cream, Lavender cream, and Peppermint cream are also used to treat itchy skin due to their anti-inflammatory and cooling effects.

preparations.preparation_desc: Calendula officinalis creams are a popular herbal remedy used to treat itchy skin ailments, such as eczema, dermatitis, and skin irritations, due to their anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. These creams help to soothe and calm itchy skin by reducing inflammation, preventing infection, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Calendula officinalis, including triterpene saponins, flavonoids, and carotenoids, contribute to its therapeutic effects by inhibiting the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines and promoting the synthesis of collagen. By using Calendula officinalis creams, individuals can experience relief from itchy skin symptoms, promote skin health, and prevent further irritation.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology", Calendula officinalis creams for itchy skin have been shown to have anti-inflammatory effects and promote wound healing, particularly when combined with Cortex Moutan and Herba Menthae, as part of a three-herbs formula.

preparations.preparation_desc: Urtica dioica creams, also known as nettle creams, have been traditionally used to treat itchy skin ailments such as eczema and dermatitis due to their anti-inflammatory and soothing properties. The bioactive constituents of Urtica dioica, including flavonoids, carotenoids, and polyphenols, help to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, thereby alleviating itchy skin symptoms. The creams work by reducing the production of histamine, a chemical responsible for itching, and also by soothing and calming the skin, providing quick relief from itchy skin conditions. The benefits of using Urtica dioica creams to treat itchy skin ailments include reduced inflammation, improved skin health, and a natural approach to managing symptoms without harsh chemicals or side effects.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Molecules (Basel, Switzerland)", Urtica dioica creams for itchy skin may be beneficial due to their anti-inflammatory properties, which can help reduce inflammation and promote faster wound healing, as demonstrated in a study where an ointment made from the extract accelerated wound healing in rats compared to untreated wounds.

preparations.preparation_desc: Aloe barbadensis creams have been widely used to treat itchy skin ailments due to their anti-inflammatory and soothing properties. The herbal preparation helps to treat this ailment by reducing redness and swelling, providing instant relief from itchiness and discomfort. The bioactive constituents of Aloe barbadensis creams, including aloin, aloe-emodin, and acemannan, possess potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that contribute to their therapeutic effects. The benefits of using Aloe barbadensis creams to treat itchy skin ailments include improved skin hydration, reduced itching and inflammation, and a faster recovery time, making it a popular natural remedy for skin health issues.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Tropical medicine & international health : TM & IH", Aloe barbadensis creams may be effective in treating itchy skin associated with conditions such as psoriasis, as demonstrated by a study where topical application of 0.5% Aloe vera extract in a hydrophilic cream resulted in significant clearing of psoriatic plaques and a decreased PASI score.

preparations.preparation_desc: Symphytum officinale creams, derived from the plant's leaves, have been traditionally used to treat eczema and other itchy skin ailments due to their anti-inflammatory and soothing properties. The creams help to treat this ailment by reducing redness, itching, and swelling, promoting a calming and cooling effect on the affected skin. The bioactive constituents, including allantoin, mucilages, and phenolic compounds, contribute to their therapeutic effects by acting as antioxidants, anti-inflammatory agents, and soothing agents that help to reduce skin irritation and promote skin regeneration. The benefits of using Symphytum officinale creams to treat itchy skin ailments include reduced inflammation, improved skin hydration, and enhanced skin comfort, making it a popular natural remedy for skin conditions.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the study, Symphytum officinale creams for itchy skin have a dermatologic importance of 63.59 on a scale of 100.

This herbal preparation helps to treat itchy skin by reducing inflammation, soothing irritated skin, and promoting wound healing, which in turn alleviates the discomfort and itchiness associated with these conditions. The bioactive constituents of Hypericum perforatum creams, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, work together to provide its therapeutic benefits, including antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects. The benefits of using Hypericum perforatum creams to treat itchy skin ailments include reduced inflammation, improved wound healing, and enhanced skin health, making it a popular natural remedy for skin conditions.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "BMC veterinary research", Hypericum perforatum creams for itchy skin have been shown to have antifungal and antibacterial effects, making them a potentially beneficial option for treating skin diseases in dogs.

preparations.preparation_desc: Echinacea purpurea creams have been traditionally used to treat itchy skin ailments, such as eczema and dermatitis, due to their anti-inflammatory and immune-boosting properties. The bioactive constituents, including alkylamides, caffeic acid, and rosmarinic acid, help to reduce inflammation and itching by inhibiting the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes and cytokines. These creams also possess antioxidant properties, which help to protect the skin from oxidative stress and promote wound healing, thus alleviating the symptoms of itchy skin conditions. The benefits of using Echinacea purpurea creams include reduced inflammation, itching, and skin irritation, as well as improved skin health and a reduced risk of infections.

The benefits of using Avena sativa creams for itchy skin treatment include natural and gentle skin care, reduced risk of skin irritation, and a soothing effect that calms the skin, providing relief from itching and discomfort.

intro_study: According to "Biological & pharmaceutical bulletin", creams for itchy skin may contain ingredients such as methanol extracts of the root of Scrophularia ningpoensis, the root of Patrinia villosa, the fruit of Forsythia suspensa, the rhizome of Cimicifuga dahurica, the aerial part of Schizonepeta tenuifolia, and the fruit of Cnidium monnieri, which have shown inhibitory activity against substance P-induced itching.
